*   The area of one equilateral triangle is $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}s^2$.
*   The total area of the parallelogram is the sum of the two hexagons and the four triangles:
    $$ \text{Total Area} = 2 \left( \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2}s^2 \right) + 4 \left( \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}s^2 \right) $$
